issues.description: Course initializer parameter ordering/signatures are inconsistent. The problem statement example and the template expect an initializer with labels and order init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) (see problem_statement.md and template Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift). In the solution, Course is implemented as init(instructor: String, name: String, ratings: [Int]) (solution Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift), while the solution's Client constructs a Course using Course(name: ..., instructor: ..., ratings: ... ) (solution Sources/DeveloperLib/Client.swift). This mismatch between the declared initializer and the call sites will cause compilation errors and confuse students about the correct initializer signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Course initializer signature consistent across artifacts. Prefer matching the problem statement and template: change the solution's initializer declaration to init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) in Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift, so its parameter labels and order match the example and the Client call sites. Alternatively, if you intentionally want the reversed order, update all call sites (Client and any examples in the problem statement) to use the new label order. Ensure tests and documentation are updated to match the chosen signature.
